info.name: OANDA v20 REST Accounts Instruments API

params.name: instrument
params.description: Name of the Instrument

params.name: price
params.description: The Price component(s) to get candlestick data for. Can contain any combination of the characters "M" (midpoint candles) "B" (bid candles) and "A" (ask candles).

params.name: granularity
params.description: The granularity of the candlesticks to fetch

params.name: count
params.description: The number of candlesticks to return in the reponse. Count should not be specified if both the start and end parameters are provided, as the time range combined with the graularity will determine the number of candlesticks to return.

params.name: from
params.description: The start of the time range to fetch candlesticks for.

params.name: to
params.description: The end of the time range to fetch candlesticks for.

params.name: smooth
params.description: A flag that controls whether the candlestick is "smoothed" or not.  A smoothed candlestick uses the previous candle's close price as its open price, while an unsmoothed candlestick uses the first price from its time range as its open price.

params.name: includeFirst
params.description: A flag that controls whether the candlestick that is covered by the from time should be included in the results. This flag enables clients to use the timestamp of the last completed candlestick received to poll for future candlesticks but avoid receiving the previous candlestick repeatedly.

params.name: dailyAlignment
params.description: The hour of the day (in the specified timezone) to use for granularities that have daily alignments.

params.name: alignmentTimezone
params.description: The timezone to use for the dailyAlignment parameter. Candlesticks with daily alignment will be aligned to the dailyAlignment hour within the alignmentTimezone.  Note that the returned times will still be represented in UTC.

params.name: weeklyAlignment
params.description: The day of the week used for granularities that have weekly alignment.

items.docs: Fetch candlestick data for an instrument.

params.name: instrument
params.description: Name of the Instrument

params.name: time
params.description: The time at which the desired price is in effect. The current price is returned if no time is provided.

items.docs: Fetch a price for an instrument. Accounts are not associated in any way with this endpoint.

params.name: instrument
params.description: Name of the Instrument

params.name: from
params.description: The start of the time range to fetch prices for.

params.name: to
params.description: The end of the time range to fetch prices for. The current time is used if this parameter is not provided.

items.docs: Fetch a range of prices for an instrument. Accounts are not associated in any way with this endpoint.

params.name: instrument
params.description: Name of the Instrument

params.name: time
params.description: The time of the snapshot to fetch. If not specified, then the most recent snapshot is fetched.
